sql: SELECT timestamp,log_attributes['operation'] AS operation,log_attributes['res.statusCode'] AS status,log_attributes['error.name'] AS error_name,log_attributes['error.errorCode'] AS error_code,log_attributes['error.statusCode'] AS error_status,log_attributes['executionTime'] AS execution_time,log_attributes['responseTime'] AS response_time,extract(log_attributes['error.raw'],'(57014|DatabaseTimeout|database_timeout|ETIMEDOUT|ECONNRESET)') AS safe_raw_code FROM logs WHERE source='storage_logs' AND toInt32OrZero(log_attributes['res.statusCode'])>=500 ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 5
